reason.why: The core value of this request is a prediction: numbers that will win next week's lottery. Fair lotteries draw random numbers, so no system can know them in advance. That is computation, not stateful records an agent reads and changes through an API. A world named for it would have to return invented numbers presented as forecasts, which misleads customers who might spend money on them. I did not reinterpret it as a ticket-tracking or customer-management service, because the request asks for the prediction itself. What would make it feasible: Ask for a lottery ticket and draw ledger, in the style of a lottery retailer or player-account system. Customers hold tickets with chosen numbers. Official draw results are recorded after each draw. Agents check tickets against results, mark them won, lost or claimed, and process prize claims. Every record would be real or seeded history, and nothing would be predicted.
